title: How a Hydroelectric Dam Works in 60 Seconds 💧⚡ #shorts
description:
The world's biggest power plant runs on falling water. A dam stores a river high in a reservoir, water rushes down a penstock, spins a turbine and generator, and transformers send the power to cities. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#hydropower #howitworks #shorts

steps.label: The Secret
steps.text: The world's biggest power plant runs on *falling water*: the Three Gorges Dam in China.

steps.label: Reservoir
steps.text: A dam blocks a river and stores water high up in a *reservoir*.

steps.label: Penstock
steps.text: Gates open, and water rushes down a giant pipe called a *penstock*.

steps.label: Turbine
steps.text: The fast water hits a *turbine*, spinning it like a giant water wheel.

steps.label: Generator
steps.text: The turbine shaft turns a *generator* above it, making electricity.

steps.label: To the Grid
steps.text: *Transformers* boost the voltage, and power lines carry it to cities. The water flows on downstream.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Height becomes *power*. Follow Inside 60 for more.
